item.name: Rune Dungeon
item.description: The primary dungeon in Sailor Piece, accessed via Dungeon Island after completing the Dungeon Master quest chain. Features 15 waves of enemies with a 5-minute timer per wave — players can die unlimited times and respawn before the timer ends. The Rune Dungeon is the only way to obtain Runes — powerful end-game modifiers that provide large damage, defense, luck, and special effect bonuses. Runes have levels that increase by completing more dungeon runs. Selectable difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Extreme — harder difficulties yield higher rune drop rates and more XP/money.

item.name: Boss Rush
item.mainRewards: Rush Coins, upgrades, Boss Rush rewards
item.importantRule: Deal at least 10% damage to receive rewards.
item.description: A 15-wave, 300-second sequential boss fighting mode accessed via Rush Keys (dropped by all enemies in-game). 1 Rush Key is required per entry. To receive rewards, players must deal at least 10% of each boss's total HP. Earn Rush Coins to purchase upgrades from the Boss Rush Shop, including the Sun Armor (+115% Defense, +87% Damage, +25% Damage Reduction when fully upgraded, costs 250 Rush Coins). Maximum full upgrade cost: 6,625 Rush Coins. Selectable difficulty: Easy, Medium, Hard, Extreme. Escanor appears as a special boss with scaling drop rates (Easy 0.6% / Medium 0.85% / Hard 1.25% / Extreme 1.85%). The Boss Rush portal is located on Sailor Island. Source: sailorpiecewiki /entries/boss-rush (2026-04-23).

item.name: Double Dungeon
item.mainRewards: Shadow Monarch rewards and rare drops
item.importantRule: Bring a strong build; this is not a normal starter dungeon.
item.description: An endgame dungeon featuring the Shadow Monarch boss. The Double Dungeon is one of the most challenging PvE encounters in Sailor Piece, requiring high-level gear and coordinated team play. Shadow Monarch drops the Monarch Blade accessory (0.75-1.5% drop rate, 140 pity).

item.name: Infinite Tower
item.mainRewards: Tower Tokens, secret rune chase, tower rewards
item.importantRule: Floor scaling and token rewards matter more than normal wave clear speed.
item.description: An endless wave-based survival gamemode released in the Massive Update (March 25, 2026). Players battle increasingly difficult waves of enemies with random debuffs every 5 floors. Features Tower Tokens (currency for upgrades), a Leaderboard system, and the 2x Luck Event bonus applies here. Buffs fixed in new servers (criss, March 30). Map built by Freakiest Builder with VFX by Zenith. Accessible to players of all levels.
